name: PRP-2026-00014
terms:
Price Validity

The prices quoted are valid for the period of 1 quarter from the date of the proposal.

Delivery lead-time

The delivery lead-time shall be as agreed from receival of down payment. EYE-Adv will make every reasonable effort to meet delivery date quoted. EYE-Adv shall not be liable for performance delays or for non-performance due to causes beyond its reasonable control.

Working Hours

All services shall be performed during EYE-Adv official working hours, 9.00 am to 5.00 p.m., Sunday through Thursday, excluding Public Holidays. Additional charges will be levied to Customer if services are requested outside these official working hours and days.

Personnel

EYE-Adv reserves the right to employ suitable personnel either through direct employment or otherwise to deliver the services in accordance to the project requirements.

Confidentiality

Each party shall undertake to treat as confidential all sensitive and proprietary information disclosed to the other party for the purpose of the provision of the services or discovered during the course of the performance of the project. For the benefit of both parties, all sensitive, proprietary, and confidential information shall be identified and clearly marked as such. Either party shall not divulge any confidential information to any third party except its own employees on the need-to-know basis. Both parties shall ensure that their employees are aware of and comply with this Clause.

Taxes

In the case where the country's law requires any form of taxes to be paid for the services rendered, the taxes shall be borne by the Customer and this shall be included in the invoices to Customer, except where tax is specifically included in our pricing.

Additional notes on price basis

Events & Exhibition elements are being priced based on rental basis, in case of need as own elements or to be warehoused, extra charges shall apply.
